newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST PAKISTAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST PAKISTAN.

text.p: Sri Lankan captain Arjuna Ranatunga won the toss and chose to bat against Pakistan in the second match of the best-of-three finals of the four-nation Independence Cup tournament on Tuesday.
Sri Lanka brought in seamer Chaminda Vaas, who did not play in the first final at Mohali because of an injury, in place of Duleep Liyanage.
Pakistan included batsman Mohammed Wasim and off-break bowler Arshad Khan in place of the injured Inzamam-ul-Haq and seamer Abdul Razzak.
Sri Lanka won the first final. If required, a third will be played in Calcutta on Wednesday.
Pakistan: Rameez Raja (captain), Saeed Anwar, Shahid Afridi, Ijaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Mohammed Wasim, Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mohammed Hussain, Aaqib Javed, Arshad Khan.

Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Arvinda De Silva, Hashan Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Chaminda Vaas, Sajeeva De Silva, Muthiah Muralitharan.
